Case reference: 2018056491.CaseDesc: On March 10, 1994, at approximately 6:15pm, Gallus Huber was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Gallus was scheduled to attend a language class but did not show up.

Case reference: 1994001800.CaseDesc: On the evening of August 5, 1989, Casey Bohun was seen for the last time by her mother when she was put to bed in her home in Delta, British Columbia. Prior to her disappearance, Casey and her family had recently moved to this area, and she was not familiar with the neighbourhood. Today, Casey may not realize that she was abducted as a child.

Case reference: 1996004360.CaseDesc: Nina Akbarian may be accompanied by her father, Naser Akbarian. The last reported sighting of Nina was on July 11, 1996 in the city of Toronto, Ontario. There is a possibility of travel to either Iran or the USA, as there are relatives residing in either of these countries.

Case reference: 1984142670.CaseDesc: On January 20, 1983, at approximately 11:00 a.m., Tania Murrell was seen for the last time as she left school to return home.

Case reference: 2014004138.CaseDesc: On November 15, 2002, Sefacag Erdinc was last seen at his residence in Mission, British Columbia. Since then, Mr. Erdinc has not been seen or heard from.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Moon and Star

Case reference: 2014001666.CaseDesc: On October 1, 1995, Shaun McEleney was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta. Shawn was known to attend the racing tracks in Edmonton and Calgary.

Case reference: 2014004671.CaseDesc: Murphy Quill was last seen in mid-July 2005. Concerns have been raised by his family and friends regarding his well-being, as it is not typical for him to be out of contact for such an extended period. Although he does not have a fixed address, Murphy is known to frequent the Main Street strip and the area near 75 Martha Street in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

Case reference: 2017029244.CaseDesc: Chantal De Montgaillard, who was aged 4 1/2 at the time of her disappearance, was last seen in the family car in Saint-Hubert, Quebec on June 4, 1972.

Shoes: Red, Plastic sandals with two fastenings

Case reference: 2019081392.CaseDesc: Casey Badger was last seen leaving his home in Edmonton, Alberta, on January 28, 2020. He was travelling on foot and wrapped in a blanket.

Scar: Right Forearm, Multiple scars on right forearm
Tattoo: Left Chest, Psalms 23 on left chest
Left Cheek, Cross on left cheek

Case reference: 2018063001.CaseDesc: On March 10, 1995, at around midnight, Ying Zhu was last seen by her boyfriend when he dropped her off at her home in Toronto, Ontario. The following day, her boyfriend arrived at Ying’s work to pick her up and found out that she had quit her job the previous week.

Case reference: 2014006123.CaseDesc: Michael Montgomery was last seen on May 22, 2013, at his residence in Mississauga, Ontario.  He was spotted in the area of HWY 16, Jasper National Park, Alberta at the end of May 2013. It’s possible that he was headed to Edmonton to look for work.

Case reference: 2014004493.CaseDesc: Guy Deschênes was last seen in June 2004 at a convenience store, while trying an Interac transaction but it didn't work, located in Rivière-du-Loup, Quebec. His vehicle was found at his home. Guy has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005245.CaseDesc: Ka Hung Mok, was last seen by a family member around June 15, 1995 in Lasalle, Québec. He left the family home alone by car. The family later discovered that the vehicle had returned to the driveway, but Ka Hung was not seen and has not been heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001237.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1973, the remains of a well nourished man were found floating in Lost Lagoon in Stanley Park that is located in Vancouver, British Columbia. He had his natural teeth and had taken his own life.

Case reference: 2018041450.CaseDesc: On July 19, 1999, Fakhri Daoud was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Fakhri had returned to his residence to gather some money, his passport, and some of his personal belongings. The day before, he had purchased a one-way flight ticket to Aman, Jordan.

Case reference: 2022032929.CaseDesc: Antonio Augosto Madeira was last seen on CCTV on July 10, 2022 at approximately 10:30 a.m., walking southbound on Winona Drive at Mulberry Crescent in Toronto, Ontario.

Deformity: Bent index finger, unknown which hand

Case reference: 2021055005.CaseDesc: On July 31, 2016, Karen Thompson was last seen at her daughter’s birthday party at Prince of Whales Park in Toronto, Ontario.

Tattoo: Left Shoulder, Elephant on left or right shoulder
Lower Back, 3 skulls on lower back

Case reference: 2013000006.CaseDesc: Joseph Taylor was last seen leaving his residence in St. Thomas, Ontario around midnight on July 30, 2001. He left his residence in a despondent state. It is believed that he has initiated a new life and potentially assumed a new identity in the Kelowna area of British Columbia. He may be working as a general labourer.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, Sword with snake around (5cm)

Case reference: 2021022793.CaseDesc: On May 30, 2021, Thomas Grise was last seen at a family residence in Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation, Alberta.

Case reference: 2006018499.CaseDesc: Tony Gikoff was last seen July 9, 1955, near Colborne, Ontario, at a property he rented to tenants. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2011000499.CaseDesc: In August 1996, Bruce Berthelot left his family residence in Leamington, Ontario. He indicated that he was going away for a little while and asked his mother for $1000. He had been unemployed for several months and was dealing with some health issues. Prior to leaving he telephoned his friends in Manitoba a number of times. His family believes that he was headed to Western Canada. He has lived in Manitoba in the past. Bruce is a skilled carpenter, and enjoys fishing and boating.  He has had no contact with any members of his family or friends since leaving.

Case reference: 2014005313.CaseDesc: On September 24, 2007, Azelea Brown last spoke to her mother who was overseas.

Case reference: 2014002159.CaseDesc: Jason Misurko was last known to be in Fort McMurray, Alberta on September 17, 1995. There have been no sightings or contact since then. His vehicle was later recovered in Enderby, B.C.

Case reference: 2014002284.CaseDesc: Richard Reitmeier has not been heard from or seen since the fall of 1988. There is not much known surrounding his disappearance.

Case reference: 2016055037.CaseDesc: Human remains were found on May 10, 2006 in a field near Mossleigh, AB. They are believed to be those of a female, over the age of 40, possibly of Caucasian or Indigenous descent, who was between 5’2” and 5’6”. The individual was missing teeth and likely wore an upper denture. The individual may have complained of joint pain due to arthritis. The remains appear to have been there from 1 to 5 years.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Cheek, Healed fracture of right cheek bone
Mark: Right Side Of Head, Large button osteoma on right side of forehead

Case reference: 2014001721.CaseDesc: On April 7, 2003, Luis Betancourt was seen for the last time when he left his home in St. Catharines, Ontario. His abandoned vehicle was later found in Niagara Falls. At the time of his disappearance, Luis was despondent and he has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2008019699.CaseDesc: On April 10, 2006, Mohmud Jiwani left his residence in Oakville to attend a business meeting in Toronto, Ontario. He never returned to his Oakville residence. His vehicle was later located in the Jarvis and Dundas area of Toronto. Despite an extensive investigation, no further information has been uncovered regarding his disappearance.

Pants: Dark Blue, Navy blue suit pants

Case reference: 2025049564.CaseDesc: Sean McCready was last seen on September 6, 2025 in Sherwood Park, Alberta. Strathcona RCMP are requesting assistance from the public in locating Sean, in order to verify his wellbeing.

Hair: Brown, Curly, Long curly hair and sports a Goatee
Backpack: Black, Small waterproof roll-backpack designed for cycling
Jacket: "STORMTEK" brand Columbian style jacket with hood
Shoes: Black, Grey, "Skechers " brand; black with grey soles
Scar: Faded scar - unknown if Left or Right Shin

Case reference: 2008008498.CaseDesc: Helen Lipinski was seen for the last time on February 3, 1987 leaving the Roman Court Bingo Hall in Niagara Falls, Ontario, with her daughter. She stepped out of the hall, leaving her purse behind. Helen has a history of mental health issues. She previously mentioned wanting to visit her sister in Chihuahua, Mexico.

Jewelry: Gold, birthstone with 7 stones, 1 was missing

Case reference: 2014005195.CaseDesc: Tommy Charpentier worked on a farm and lived with his employer in Sainte-Brigitte-des-Saults, Quebec. On the night of December 15, 2008, tracks in the snow indicate that Tommy may have walked on the Nicolet River that passes in front of the farm. Tommy’s clothes were found on the frozen surface of the river, near an opening in the ice. This suggests that Tommy may have jumped into the icy waters of the Nicolet River.

Scar: Ears, Right ear piercing without earring
Chest, Left nipple piercing without a ring

Case reference: 2014005293.CaseDesc: On the morning of January 20, 1999, Abdol Hossein was seen for the last time as he left his residence in Toronto, Ontario.

Scar: Cheek, Welts all over his face and cheek

Case reference: 2006011099.CaseDesc: Kenneth Richard Wolf was working on Caribou Lake, (15 km north west of Armstrong, Ontario). On October 8, 1970, he left alone in a 16 foot steel boat to work on a dock. A search of the area has failed to locate Kenneth.

Case reference: 2014004933.CaseDesc: On May 3, 1987, at approximately 7:00pm, Jimmy Hong was last seen by his friend in Toronto, Ontario. His friend indicated that Jimmy had left for Hamilton, Ontario, and would be returning the following Monday.

Case reference: 2014003382.CaseDesc: On May 27, 1988, Stanley Umpherville and a friend were driving to The Pas, Manitoba where they stayed the night. In the morning the two departed The Pas via a 20 foot yawl with the intent on going to Easterville. They departed the Umpherville settlement around 1300hrs and they briefly stopped at Pine Bluff around 1600 hrs. It is believed they then stopped at a friend's trappers cabin at Rat Hunting and ate a meal. The last thing the survivor remembers, is seeing the lights of Easterville and he crawled to the front of the boat where he fell asleep. He awoke around 0500 hrs the next day and Stanley was no longer in the boat and he was adrift. Numerous islands and shorelines in the area were searched, and several air and water patrols were made without success. Stanley has not been located and his whereabouts are unknown.

Hat: Grey, Baseball style with "Hi Ho Hi Ho" on front

Case reference: 2006005199.CaseDesc: On Friday, July 1, 2005, at approximately 3:00 p.m., Laura Flanagan departed her cottage with the intention of canoeing around Halls Lake in the Algonquin Highlands region of Ontario. Members of the local community reported seeing her alone in the canoe. A search of the lake revealed that her canoe had been washed up on the east side of the lake. Despite an exhaustive search of the lake, Laura remained unlocated.

Bathing Suit: Blue, Green, One piece, floral pattern

Case reference: 2011000699.CaseDesc: On May 23 1985, William Drake walked out of the Pinecrest Home for senior citizens, where he lived.  He was last seen at 9:30 am walking eastbound on highway 17 in Kenora, near the Sunset Husky gas station.  His family and friends have not heard from him since. He is reported to be hard of hearing and diabetic.

Pants: Light Blue, small checks and suspenders

Case reference: 2014003281.CaseDesc: On November 14, 1971, at around 6:30 am, Eileen “Gail” McCarthy was last seen leaving her home in Edmonton, Alberta to go to work at the Misericordia Hospital. Eileen worked as a nurse and did not arrive at work that day. She has not been seen or heard from since.

Coat: Brown, White, Brown Coat with White Fur Collar

Case reference: 2008003999.CaseDesc: Bernard Champagne was last seen on July 10, 1997.  He was a man who resided alone in a cabin for 40 years. This cabin was located behind the Rodrigue residence in Mattice-Val Côté, Ontario. It had no running water or electricity.  Richard Rodrigue was concerned that night had fallen and Bernard had not returned to his cabin.  Richard informed the authorities, who conducted a search with the assistance of a police canine unit and helicopter, but were unable to locate Bernard.

Hat: Purple, Lavender, Mauve, "Polaris" brand baseball cap

Case reference: 2017062421.CaseDesc: Matthew Wiinikainen was seen for the last time on March 30, 1995 in Gaspé, Quebec. Matthew was in detention at the Youth Center “Unité La Rade”, located in Gaspé hospital area, Quebec. He escaped around 11:00 p.m. during the change of the guard.

Case reference: 2012020077.CaseDesc: On October 17, 1986, Alexander Wiwchar, 72 years old, was last seen at 2:00 p.m. in Yorkton, SK. Alexander, who lived on a farm near Canora, SK, was seen at the Yorkton Bus Depot. Alexander is believed to have had some medical concerns and was suspected of having Alzheimer’s disease. His destination was unknown and he has not been seen or located since.

Mark: Chest, 9th rib fractured on the right side

Case reference: 2014006235.CaseDesc: A lake freighter capsized in a violent storm on Lake Winnipeg, just north of Hecla Island, Manitoba. The vessel carried nine crew members and one passenger. There was only one survivor who managed to float on a piece of the wreckage to safety. All of the bodies of the remaining occupants were recovered with the exception of Allan Clemens and Tache Everett who were never located. Autopsies confirmed that the causes of death for those recovered were either drowning or death due to exposure in the cold water. Allan and Tache are presumed dead due to drowning.

Case reference: 2014005960.CaseDesc: On December 26th, 2012 at approximately 11:45 am Raymond Nothdurft was last observed near the Table Rock in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Raymond was despondent.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Short, Wears a moustache
Jewelry: Gold, Wedding Ring, Left Ring Finger, Three to four small diamonds in a diagonal
Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Ring, Right Little Finger, No lettering or logo
Scar: Right Knee, Small laparoscopic surgical scar on knee cap
Left Knee, Small laparoscopic surgical scar on knee cap
Tattoo: Right Ankle, Soccer ball with red maple leaf on outside

Case reference: 2018029665.CaseDesc:
On May 29, 2018, at approximately 12:40 p.m., Vernon Otto last spoke with his wife
over the telephone, as he was on their property in St. Clements, Manitoba. During the
course of their conversation, Vernon had told his wife that he was going to speak with
a neighbour about vehicle ramps he had lent to him. Vernon had also told her that he
was going to go the Interlake area to look at farm machinery, specifically a crawler.
Vernon's truck was found burnt on May 30th, 2018, at 5:20 pm, a few miles from his
residence.

Case reference: 2009004999.CaseDesc: At the time of her disappearance, Dawn Carisse was a patient of the North Bay Psychiatric Hospital. She is generally very pleasant though suffers from short term memory loss due to cardiac arrest several years earlier.  Dawn always spoke of leaving the hospital and going to where she believed her family would be. Her family was in the Kirkland Lake area and then moved to Sudbury. She was aware of both, and her possible destinations were Kirkland Lake or Sudbury. She was last seen on Highway 11 North, in North Bay, Ontario.

Hair: Brown, Curly, Parted in centre, short bangs
Dress: Maroon, Pink, Long dress with faint white flowers, short sleeves and front buttons.
Luggage: May have had a dark duffle bag in her possession.

Case reference: 2023055243.CaseDesc: Adam Payne was last seen on August 8, 2023, in Kingsville, Ontario.  He was seen getting into a canoe with a red dinghy attached to the back of it and head westbound into Lake Erie.

Case reference: 2014004895.CaseDesc: Desmond Peter's grandmother saw him for the last time on March 6, 2007, she reported him missing a few days later. Desmond was not happy with his home life and would often leave the house for days, but he would always return.  During the first year of his disappearance there were several unconfirmed sightings of Desmond, however none of them were considered reliable enough to confirm his whereabouts.  All tips and information brought to the investigators continues to be followed up on.

Case reference: 2018071052.CaseDesc: On July 11, 1998, the remains of a male individual were discovered on Sulphur Mountain in Banff National Park. There is dental work present, including multiple fillings. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 6 months and 5 years.

Case reference: 2019073876.CaseDesc: On November 1, 2019, Anton Katona was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002387.CaseDesc: Johan Degooyer was reported missing by his family on September 29, 1998. His vehicle was located on the banks of Lake Ontario near the Port of Oshawa. Witnesses reported seeing a man paddling a canoe in the vicinity. It is believed that this man was Johan Degooyer. An extensive search of Lake Ontario and the shoreline was conducted, but Johan was not located.

Case reference: 2024058677.CaseDesc: On November 1, 2024, Gary Brandon Reno was reported missing in Fort St John, British Columbia. We have not had any contact with Gary since October 20, 2024. Gary was last known to be living and working in the Pink Mountain area. He was driving a 2014 black Mitsubishi Outlander.

Shirt: Red, Grey, Red hoodie with grey spots
Deformity: Left Hip, Only half of his hip socket
Scar: Right Knee, Scar on knee, unknown which side
Tattoo: Left Ear, Text "Luca"' behind left ear
Left Forearm, Flames inside left forearm

Case reference: 2018043194.CaseDesc: On July 13, 1990, Laura Hamilton was last seen by her fiancé leaving a restaurant in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002313.CaseDesc: On April 5, 1986 Donald Smith was observed in the area of the Whirlpool Bridge in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance Donald was despondent and had trouble walking due to arthritis.

Teeth: False, Upper dentures and missing teeth
Amputation: Left Index Finger, Tip of left index missing

Case reference: 2012020137.CaseDesc: On Friday September 27, 1963, Diane Carrier left home and went to the neighbourhood park in the Old Quebec district of Quebec City, Quebec, to advise her brother to return home for dinner. Diane's brother returned home alone and Diane has never been seen since.

Case reference: 2014001485.CaseDesc: On July 31, 1981, Mohamad Daher was seen for the last time as he left his residence, in the Anjou district in Montreal, Quebec, for a business meeting. His vehicle was found at Le Boulevard Shopping Centre in the Saint-Leonard neighbourhood. Mohamad has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014006541.CaseDesc: Roxanne Fleming was last seen in the Michaels Park neighbourhood of Edmonton, Alberta, on December 27, 1986.  Following the last contact, she has been based in Lillooet, Kamloops, Vancouver (British Columbia), Red Deer (Alberta).  We are unaware of the circumstances of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014004813.CaseDesc: Germain Gaudreault was seen for the last time on August 26, 2006, around noon in the area of the municipality of Baie-Ste-Catherine, Quebec. He was alone in his 1997 white Plymouth on Highway 138 eastbound. His unoccupied vehicle was found later that evening on the wharf of the municipality of Les Escoumins, Quebec.

Hat: Cotton, Black, "Cuba" text with Cuban flag
Tattoo: Chest, Blue dot for medical treatments

Case reference: 2014001691.CaseDesc: Norman Krolman was last seen withdrawing money from an ATM machine.  He was a self-employed computer programmer and was in business with a partner.  He had a steady girlfriend and a small circle of friends.

Case reference: 2014001898.CaseDesc: According to her husband, Isabell Brooks left her home near Highway 7 and Tenth Concession (now Reesor Road) in Markham, Ontario on foot on March 4, 1972. Isabell said she'd return in a week, but she was never seen again.

Mark: Head, Mole on top of head

Case reference: 2014001313.CaseDesc: On August 26, 1976, at 11:00 pm, Frederick Seymour was seen for the last time as he stood outside of his residence in the Village of Kars, south of Ottawa, Ontario. Frederick had been seen by his neighbour.

Case reference: 2012020064.CaseDesc: On June 24, 2000, Irma Murdock was seen for the last time in Winnipeg, Manitoba. It is believed that Irma may have travelled to Vancouver, British Colombia.

Case reference: 2014004864.CaseDesc: On November 6, 2006, at approximately 9:00 a.m., Ahmed Moalin-Mohamed was seen for the last time as he left his apartment to search for employment in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016068715.CaseDesc: On July 21, 2013, the body of an adult male was found floating in the Niagara River across from the Youngstown Marina, NY, USA near the Niagara-On-The-Lake Sailing Club, Ontario, Canada. Anthropological analysis has suggested that he is black, although there are some features which suggest that he may be mixed Black and Caucasian. He is described as obese however this may be due to post-mortem changes. He is thought to have been in the water for at least one year to possibly several years.

Case reference: 2011001499.CaseDesc: At the time of his disappearance, Luke Joly-Durocher was visiting friends in North Bay, Ontario. He resides in Temiskaming, Quebec. Video surveillance showed Luke being refused entry into Cecil's Eatery and Beer Society at approximately 11:54 p.m. He left by himself and has not been seen or heard from since that time.

Belt: Purple, Lavender, Mauve, Black, Studded belt, black on the front and purple around the waist
Shirt: Grey, T-shirt, may have had a small purple animal logo on the bottom corner
Deformity: Right Forearm, Thinner than left forearm

Case reference: 2014001059.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1970, the body of a heavyset young adult male with black hair was found on the shore of Kamloops Lake in British Columbia. He had all his teeth removed during his life and had no noticeable scars or tattoos. He is believed to have drowned in the Thompson River near Riverside Park a few days earlier.

Jacket: Nylon, Light Blue, Squall brand with hood, golfer label on front with zipper
Shirt: Blue, Yellow, Corsair brand, checkered pattern
Blue, Longsleeve, Lancer Brand, Size Large, Blue with purple and black check pattern, longsleeve
White, Bluestone brand, long sleeves, size medium
Shoes: Brown, Oxfords, Vibram brand, made in Italy, with shoe laces

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2005001999.CaseDesc: In September 1979, Norman Ritchie, was a passenger in a 16 foot cedar strip boat on Georgian Bay near Cove Island, when it capsized. Five victims were recovered, but Norman has never been located. He is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2023031497.CaseDesc: On 2022-06-02, Michael Vanrookhuyzen was last seen in Chaplin, Saskatchewan where he had mentioned that he was going to see a friend in Toronto, Ontario.  Michael has not been seen or heard from his family or friends in over a year. Michael suffers from paranoid schizophrenia.

Case reference: 2014001247.CaseDesc: On July 3, 1989, Henry and his brother, William Gerbrand, were fishing in a canoe on Codette Lake near Nipawin, Saskatchewan. At approximately 8:00 p.m., boaters reported hearing calls for help. It is suspected that both men drowned; despite extensive efforts, they were not located by divers.

Case reference: 2015013522.CaseDesc: Richard St. Peter was in the process of moving residences. He was last heard from around Saturday March 14, 2015. It is not known where he may have gone, but he had vacated his last apartment and did not officially move into his new home.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Short, Receding hairline, salt and pepper goatee

Case reference: 2010004099.CaseDesc: Timmy Villemaire was last seen by his family in the Cambridge, Ontario area sometime between mid-June and mid-September of 2001. He was showing signs that he may have been suffering from a mental health disorder at the time of his disappearance.

Hair: Brown, Wavy, Short, Beard, Moustache, Sideburns

Case reference: 2014005501.CaseDesc: On October 7, 2010 around midnight, Fred Byram was last seen exiting the Rockin Rodeo bar and getting into a taxi on Elmwood Drive in Moncton, New Brunswick.

Hair: Grey, Brush Cut, Salt and Pepper hair, 2-3-day stubble
Tattoo: Left Shoulder, Blue wolf and moon with tree
Right Wrist, Barbwire, green and grey

Case reference: 2013000074.CaseDesc: Pasquale Giannetti has been missing from Montreal, Quebec since November 26, 1984. Pasquale's vehicle was located at St Helen's Island and his clothes were found on the Jacques Cartier Bridge.

Case reference: 2014002751.CaseDesc: Rebecca Guno was last seen in June of 1983 by her common law husband. Miss Guno was taking a bus downtown with an unknown female friend, but did not arrive at her intended destination.

Case reference: 2015011654.CaseDesc: On December 3, 1994, a baby was found in the Rivière des Prairies between the island of Montréal and the Visitation park Island in the Ahuntsic neighborhood. The body was naked and had a plastic bag wrapped around the wrist. According to experts the body would have been in the water since the fall.

Case reference: 2014004557.CaseDesc: On January 23, 1992, at approximately 8:30am, Oscar Casaseca was seen for the last time by his wife in Toronto, Ontario. Oscar’s wife had seen him before she returned to work, and when she returned home he was gone.

Case reference: 2008000799.CaseDesc: On August 26th, 1986 Terry Field and Linda Blackwell left Lost Nation Airport, east of Cleveland, Ohio en route to Brantford Municipal Airport, Brantford, Ontario.  The plane was 18 minutes into its flight when the pilot communicated with Cleveland Air Traffic Control that they were encountering severe turbulence.  They requested new vectors to fly. The pilot was advised to turn west, then Air Traffic Control lost radio and radar contact with the plane. Debris from the plane was located on August 27, 1986 in Lake Erie, approximately 32 nautical miles south of the St.Thomas Airport. Debris was drifting in a southeast direction and was recovered approximately 1-3 nautical miles on the Canadian side of the international boundary line in Lake Erie. Debris was identified by Bud Field,  brother of Terry Field, as having come from the missing aircraft.

Case reference: 2020016353.CaseDesc: In April 2020, Travis Hollar last contacted his family. During the time of his disappearance, Travis was residing in Edmonton, Alberta, and was living a transient lifestyle. In the past, he suffered from a brain injury which caused diminished cognitive abilities.

Case reference: 2014003393.CaseDesc: The last confirmed contact between James Siwy and his family was in 1982 in the Drumheller, Alberta area.  Shortly thereafter, he relocated to Ontario with some acquaintances.  They were travelling in a 1975 white four-door Dodge Monaco with a burgundy roof.  In 1984, the Monaco was discovered in Ontario. There were unconfirmed reports that he may have been hitchhiking in the Northern Ontario region.  In 1994, James' family reported him missing after attempting to notify him about the death of a family member.

Hair: Brown, Wavy, Long, Parted in the middle

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2014002842.CaseDesc: On August 17, 1971, Stella St. Arnault was seen for the last time as she ran into a treed area in John D’or Prairie Reserve in Alberta. Prior to her disappearance, Stella had had an argument with a family member.

Case reference: 2006011999.CaseDesc: On November 8, 1972, Henry King and Vancel Mcleod left King's Fishing Camp on Lake Huron to travel by boat to Thessalon where they were to deliver fish. They never arrived at the intended destination.

Scar: Left Thumb, 1/2 to 3/4 inch in length.

Case reference: 2012020089.CaseDesc: Michel Guy Favreau lived alone in Nipawin, Saskatchewan at the time of his disappearance. Michel suffered from depression and he was last heard from and seen between September 22nd and September 25th, 2011. On October 4th, 2011 his vehicle, a 1998 green Chrysler Intrepid, was located abandoned at Carroll's Cove camp ground near Nipawin. Several searches were conducted in hopes of locating him were unsuccessful.

Case reference: 2014005017.CaseDesc: On July 7, 1967, Margaret Mildred Batoche was reported missing from her family residence in Bonnyville, Alberta. Margaret always kept in contact with her family and friends, and her disappearance is considered suspicious.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Missing lower molars on both sides
Mark: Right Cheek, Wart on right cheek close to ear
Tattoo: Left Shoulder, Tattoo "H" on left shoulder

Case reference: 2006018899.CaseDesc: William Bowman was last seen leaving his hunting camp, 83 kilometres north of the Town of Massey, Ontario, at the north end of Hwy.# 810, District Algoma, Monestine Township on October 15, 1979.

Case reference: 2014002675.CaseDesc: Richard Monroe was last seen on October 2nd, 2001 by the owners of Serge's Restaurant on Elgin Street in the city of Greater Sudbury. Richard is believed to have suffered from dementia. He spent most of his time in Thessalon, Sault Ste. Marie, Dunn's Valley, Sudbury and British Columbia.

Case reference: 2021001787.CaseDesc: On January 10, 2021, Sébastien Lavallée was seen for the last time when he left his residence. Sébastien had mentioned that he was going to go for a walk on the lake in the ‘MRC des Deux-Montagnes’ in Quebec. During the time of his disappearance, Sébastien was engaged in a high-risk lifestyle, and was suffering from mental health problems.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Implant retained dentures, upper and lower

Case reference: 2014001690.CaseDesc: On December 7, 1971, James MacDonald departed Thompson, Manitoba in his "Money Mark 21" aircraft bound for Winnipeg. James never arrived. Despite intensive air search neither James nor his aircraft have been located.

Jewelry: Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Engineering ring
Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Calendar watch

Case reference: 2005002599.CaseDesc: On October 21, 1989, an unidentified man was discovered in the area of County Road 14 in Napanee, Ontario.  Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts that this man was of south Asian ancestry.

Shirt: White, Brand: Pierre Cardin; grey, blue, and red thin stripes

Case reference: 2018045881.CaseDesc: In July of 2018 Tatianna Cuevas was taken on vacation by her father John Varga from Toronto, Ontario to Paris, France. It is the belief that she was abducted by her father as they have not returned to Canada on the agreed upon date.

Case reference: 2013000031.CaseDesc: On October 31, 2007, Edward D’Souza went missing from his home in Oakville, Ontario. Investigators believe that Edward travelled to Mumbai, India and may now be living in the Middle East under an assumed name.

Case reference: 2012020104.CaseDesc: On Saturday, April 15, 2006, Francis Albert-Cloutier was seen for the last time at his home located in Saint-Marc-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. His vehicle, a black 2001 Chrysler Intrepid, was found on the following day by a passerby on an ATV trail in Saint-Amable, Quebec. No one has since seen or heard from Francis.

Jewelry: Gold, Ring with coloured stone on each middle finger

Case reference: 2014002167.CaseDesc: On July 7, 1973, William Gorrie and his family were seen by a an RCMP patrol boat returning from a day of fishing in Cross Bay, Manitoba. The waves increased in height and he followed the patrol boat, eventually getting his family on board. As a result, the patrol boat had to increase its power, significantly increasing the distance between the two boats. The last sighting of Mr. Gorrie's boat was approximately 1 km behind the patrol boat. An immediate search by air was conducted with negative results. It is presumed that William drowned as neither he nor the boat were ever located.

Case reference: 2016030725.CaseDesc: Bryan Twan was reported missing in Quesnel, British Columbia, on June 7, 2016.  Bryan was last seen near Quesnel's West Park Mall and has not been seen or heard from since.

Jacket: Denim, Light Blue, Yellow Drilling Rig Logo
Tattoo: Right Arm, BEV Heart and Unicorn

Case reference: 2023036470.CaseDesc: Ryan Liu was last seen by his brother on July 9, 2023 as he left the family residence in Richmond, British Columbia.  On the same night, Ryan was also captured on video in West Vancouver, British Columbia.  Ryan has not been seen or heard from since.

Shirt: Cream, Ivory, T Shirt, Large logo on the front

Case reference: 2014004475.CaseDesc: On the morning of October 1, 1976, Crystal Van Huuksloot was seen for the last time with her suitcases in Toronto, Ontario. Crystal had traveled from Edmonton, Alberta to help raise funds for her boyfriend. She stayed in Toronto for one week, but did not board her return flight to Edmonton.

Case reference: 2015049499.CaseDesc: Loretta Garrett's husband and friends reported her missing on July 19, 1961 from Moose Brook River in Northesk Parish, New Brunswick. They were on a fishing trip and shared a car and parked near the trailhead. The men hiked across a trail until they reached the water to fish, while the women remained in the car. Shortly after, Loretta complained about the heat and bugs and started down the same trail as the men, but she was never seen again.

Case reference: 2006016699.CaseDesc: Michael Gadke and Morris Werenko were last seen in the vicinity of Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario, and were last heard from as they were circling over Goulais Bay in a Cessna C-172 aircraft. The Cessna C-172 model features white wings with red tips, a red fuselage with a white stripe, and a white underside. The top of the engine cowling was red.

Case reference: 2014005431.CaseDesc: Mahendiran Ratnasingam last spoke with his ex-wife on June 8th, 2006, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2018034585.CaseDesc: On September 1, 2004, at approximately 8:00 am, Stephen Lawrence was seen for the last time leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Stephen had said he would be home in a few hours.

Shirt: Blue, Brand: Calvin Klein; long sleeves

Case reference: 2016068490.CaseDesc: On September 25, 1971, Mr. Georges Turcotte went missing from the Saint-Hyacinthe, Quebec area. Georges was last seen at his home with his wife.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Snake or zig zag
